environment.description: Migration WebSocket server deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with security group allowing inbound TCP 8765 from 0.0.0.0/0. MIGRATION_SECRET set to 'dev-secret' (default). pgBouncer running in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 connecting to RDS PostgreSQL. No origin validation on WebSocket connections. The DB_USER 'migrator' has DDL and DML privileges on all schemas.

config.network: public subnet, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8765
